Reachable keeps the text of a hidden element and drops template content

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>visible</p><div role=\"tabpanel\" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>", "{\"hidden_content\":\"Reachable\"}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
